From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity drift reset: 48h close window + accountable owners

Team —

We ran a quick query against SF and the attached export shows ~24 opportunities that have moved into ‘Final Review’/’Proposal’ but haven’t had owner activity in >=21 days. Finance flagged these as the primary source of our forecast drift this month. I’m asking for a short, pragmatic cleanup so Forecast is actionable before Friday’s readout.

Ask (48-hour window):
- Each listed opportunity must have a single accountable owner assigned in SF (Owner field).
- Update Stage to the most defensible current stage and set an explicit Close Date (no more placeholders).
- Add a comment in the Opportunity feed with the next concrete milestone (e.g., PO ETA, Legal redline due).

Deliverables:
1) Owners confirm ownership / reassign by EOD tomorrow.
2) Short notes (one line) on each opp in the comments field by EOD Friday.

I’ve flagged the highest-risk accounts in acct-risk-matrix.pdf (page 1). Ben and Lauren — please coordinate offline on any deals you want to escalate to CS or Product for blocker removal. Vivek — can you run the post-cleanse export for Finance once this is done?

I’ll consolidate and push an adjusted commit to the forecast. Short and practical — no long discussions.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: open-opps-export.csv (CSV, 27 rows), acct-risk-matrix.pdf (2 pages)

1) Can we add a column for "last owner activity" (last log comment or logged event)? That will help avoid reassigning opportunities that actually have activity in other systems (CS notes, Zendesk tickets).
2) For Acme Health (rows 3 & 4) — Daniel indicated they pushed procurement review to next week. Should we set Close Date to 2026-08-12 (realistic) or keep the current quarter?

If we move close dates out, Finance will want to see the net impact on commit. Vivek — once you run the post-cleanse export, can you include Stage, Close Date, Owner, and last-owner-activity?

- Ben: agree on the last-owner-activity column. I’ve added that to the shared export (see Drive link). Please do not reassign any opps where last-owner-activity is <21 days.
- Acme Health: we’ll move Close Date to 2026-08-12 for the two procurement-blocked opps and mark them as "At Risk — Procurement" in the Stage reason. I’ll note expected $ impact in the forecast comment.
- Vivek: please run the post-cleanse export and drop it into the Drive folder by 2pm PT today. Finance needs it for the 4pm commit adjustment call.
- Lauren/Monica: escalate any opportunities where customer technical sign-off is required — we want Product/CS involved before we change Close Dates.

I’ll consolidate inputs and push the adjusted commit to SF/Forecast by 3:30pm. If anything unexpected pops up, call me directly.

One-line summary for Finance: 18 opps validated, 6 moved out of quarter (procurement/legal), net commit reduction $218k. Full export + notes in Drive.

Thanks,
Priya
